rationale: CSS-only restore of the EPMCDME-13930 wrap classes inside the EPMCDME-8582 toggle button. All three lenses ran. Acceptance: 15/15 pass. Blind lens raised 8 layout nits (inline-block wrap unit, ml-2 spacing, items-start optical alignment, tall wrapped rows) that match the original approved plan and are dismissed or deferred. Edge-case: whitespace-only output_field is pre-existing and dismissed; long type-label overflow is dismissed because mapping type labels are bounded option strings and inline-block is the spec-prescribed wrap unit. 0 blocking findings. 8 dismissed, 1 deferred (line-clamp / max height for very long names, out of scope).

business_review.item: Mapping row header text must not overlap the delete (trash) icon.
business_review.notes: Header and toggle use items-start; field span has flex-1 min-w-0 break-words; delete Button retains shrink-0.

business_review.item: Long output field names and the mapping type suffix must wrap within the row instead of overflowing on the right.
business_review.notes: break-words on the field-name span; type suffix is inline-block with a leading space (ml-2 removed).

business_review.item: The keyboard-accessible toggle button (type=button, aria-expanded, aria-label) introduced by EPMCDME-8582 must be preserved.
business_review.notes: Existing toggle button attributes unchanged; only items-center → items-start on className.

business_review.item: Prevent chevron and delete icons from being compressed; wrap long output_field names; align icons to the first line.
business_review.notes: Chevron keeps shrink-0 and gains mt-0.5; delete Button already has shrink-0 and mt-0.5; items-start on header and toggle.

business_review.item: Tailwind-only styling with semantic theme tokens and cn() for conditional classes.
business_review.notes: Diff only changes Tailwind className strings; tokens unchanged; chevron still uses cn() for rotate.

business_review.item: Type label is inline-block with a space before it (not ml-2); text span has min-w-0 break-words.

standards_review.notes: EPMCDME-13930: Restore mapping row text wrapping around the delete icon
Tailwind-only class restore; no custom CSS, inline styles, or raw palette tokens.
Presentational layout classes only; no auth, secrets, or injection surface.
